line: You domestic, all I ride is foreign shit
vault_lines: You domestic, all I ride is foreign shit
meaning:
21 Savage employs a double entendre of sorts in this line.

He states that he rides in “foreign shit”, meaning that he owns luxury cars that were manufactured outside of the USA (Lamborghini, Ferrari, etc). 21 juxtaposes this with his peers, who he describes as “domestic”.

“Domestic” can have the meaning of “within one’s own country”, or the opposite of international. In this way, he implies that others around him don’t have the fancy foreign cars that he can afford, and they must resort to riding in a boring, domestic car as a result.

Additionally, “domestic” can also be used to describe an animal that has been tamed and acquainted to human life (like house pets). 21 Savage clarifies in this line that he’s not domestic, meaning that he’s not a tamed animal like those around him. This falls in line with his earlier statement in the song:

Bitch, I’m a dog

Through these lines, 21 implies that he’s a wild animal of sorts, and is therefore dangerous and follows no human leader.

line: Hit my first lick, went and bought a Marni collar
vault_lines: Hit my first lick, went and bought a Marni collar (On God)

A “lick” is a common nickname for robbing a place or a person.

21 is implying after he had successfully robbed somebody for the first time, he went and bought himself a “Marni Collar” which  refers to a collared shirt by luxury fashion brand, Marni.

line: Gucci garments, kush smell like armpits
vault_lines: Gucci garments, kush smell like armpits

Gucci is a high end Italian clothing brand.
In this line, 21 enforces the fact he is wearing designer clothes.

Marijuana, commonly nicknamed as “Kush” has a particular smell that is occasionally compared to human body odour. The majority of body odour comes from the armpits. The stronger the smell of the marijuana, assumably the product is as well.

21 Savage is saying he has high quality clothes and marijuana.

line: Draco in the seat make you chicken noodle soup (Yeah)
